title: BRIEFING
universal_lens: The Week 6 master pipeline unifies discrete roster constraints, continuous multivariate tail dependence, and combinatorial budget optimization into a single constrained stochastic manifold. By enforcing positive semi-definite covariance structures via Higham repair and applying hard exclusionary boundary conditions (LiveRosterGate), the system guarantees mathematically coherent state transitions across props, SGPs, and DFS lineups.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps archival DraftKings half-point lines to LogNormal-tailed marginal distributions for player props, ensuring continuous un-tied conviction scores. For SGPs, a 50,000-draw Student-t copula with degrees of freedom \(\nu=4.0\) models heavy-tailed joint dependencies, strictly enforcing that true joint probabilities exceed independent product baselines to isolate genuine positive expected value edges.
gse_mapping: GSE enforces situational integrity through a fail-closed LiveRosterGate operator, projecting zero inactive or doubtful entities into the active state space. Combinatorial DFS optimizations are bounded by strict salary caps and temporal exclusions (e.g., early-kickoff teams), while dynamic cognitive signals from FTN charting continuously modulate the underlying transition matrices.

primitives.name: Fail-Closed LiveRosterGate Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Fail-closed LiveRosterGate (zero OUT/IR/Doubtful/PUP players in Props, SGPs, DFS).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \( \mathcal{A} \): Active roster set; \( S_i \in \{OUT, IR, Doubtful, PUP\} \): Dimensionless injury status indicator for entity \( i \); \( \mathbb{I}_{active}(S_i) \): Boolean projection operator.
primitives.assumptions: Injury reports provide a definitive binary partition between available and unavailable entities prior to market generation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity occurs if late-breaking injury data introduces non-binary probabilistic availability states not captured by the initial gate.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to a hard constraint projector in a Hilbert space, collapsing the wavefunction of any entity with \( S_i \notin \text{Active} \) to exactly zero amplitude across all downstream GSI/GSE operators.
layer2.telemetry: Count of excluded entities per game; must equal total reported non-active players.

primitives.name: Student-t Copula Positive EV Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: - SGPs: 8 games, 50,000-draw Student-t copula (`nu=4.0`), Higham PSD repair, true_prob > indep_prob, positive EV, 0 inactives.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \( \mathbf{u} \in [0,1]^d \): Vector of uniform marginals; \( \Sigma \): Correlation matrix (dimensionless); \( \nu = 4.0 \): Degrees of freedom (dimensionless); \( t_d \): Multivariate Student-t CDF.
primitives.assumptions: Team performance metrics exhibit heavy-tailed joint dependencies adequately modeled by an elliptical copula family.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if the empirical correlation matrix is severely ill-conditioned such that Higham's nearest PSD repair alters the structural dependencies beyond acceptable tolerance.

layer2.mapping: Derives the true joint probability kernel \( P(A \cap B) \) from the repaired \( \Sigma \). The GSI edge is explicitly defined as \( \Delta = P(A \cap B) - P(A)P(B) > 0 \).
layer2.telemetry: Difference between true joint probability and independent product baseline; number of Monte Carlo draws satisfying the SGP condition.

primitives.name: DFS Temporal & Budget Constraint Manifold
primitives.verbatim_quote: - 09:30 AM CST Urgent Directive: Exclude HOU and JAX from DFS optimal lineups (kicked off 8:30 AM CST / 13:30 UTC); integrate 2026 FTN charting, vision metrics (SOE, ART, pocket depth), cognitive signals; include social-media-ready executive summary block in master packet.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: \( c_j \): Salary cost of player \( j \) (USD); \( C_{max} = 50,000 \): Salary cap (USD); \( T_{kickoff} \): Game start time (UTC/CST); \( \mathcal{T}_{excl} \): Set of excluded team IDs.
primitives.assumptions: Optimal lineup construction requires strict adherence to budget limits and temporal causality (cannot select players from already commenced games).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if the exclusion of temporally advanced teams (HOU, JAX) combined with budget constraints leaves the feasible solution space empty.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a constrained integer programming problem where the objective function is augmented by continuous cognitive signal weights (FTN metrics), subject to hard temporal veto masks.
layer2.telemetry: Number of valid lineups generated; average projected points per dollar; zero inclusion rate for excluded teams.

The mathematical architecture of the Week 6 master pipeline relies on the sequential application of rigorous filtering and stochastic modeling operators. Initially, the `fail_closed_roster_gate` acts as a Dirac delta filter over the domain of player availability, instantaneously reducing the dimensionality of the state space by projecting all non-active entities to a null vector. This ensures that subsequent probabilistic evaluations operate exclusively on a valid, contiguous subspace of actionable assets. Following this topological reduction, the `student_t_copula_sgp` operator constructs a high-dimensional dependency manifold. By utilizing a Student-t distribution with \(\nu=4.0\), the model explicitly accounts for fat-tailed risks inherent in sports outcomes, avoiding the Gaussian underestimation of extreme co-movements. The Higham PSD repair algorithm guarantees that the correlation matrix \(\Sigma\) remains mathematically sound, preventing numerical instabilities during the 50,000-draw Monte Carlo simulation. The core epistemic gain arises when the simulated joint probability strictly exceeds the product of independent marginals, isolating a true statistical edge. Finally, the `dfs_temporal_exclusion` primitive imposes a complex, multi-variable optimization landscape. It integrates continuous cognitive features—such as Expected Points Added (EPA) derivatives from FTN charting—into a discrete knapsack-style solver. The temporal veto against early-kickoff teams (HOU, JAX) introduces a causal boundary condition, ensuring that the optimization respects real-time information flow. The entire system is validated through a deterministic verification script, confirming that the abstract mathematical constraints perfectly align with the concrete deliverables of the JSON and markdown packets.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This pipeline inherits directly from the foundational work in copula theory pioneered by Sklar, extended into financial risk management by Embrechts et al. for modeling market crashes via heavy tails. The use of Higham's nearest correlation matrix algorithm traces back to numerical linear algebra solutions for ill-posed covariance estimation. Furthermore, the fail-closed gate mirrors fault-tolerant control systems in aerospace engineering, where unsafe states are deterministically pruned before dynamic trajectory optimization occurs.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The system models the opposing decision actor—the sportsbook market maker—as an entity attempting to balance liability using standard Gaussian assumptions and delayed injury integrations. By deploying a Student-t copula, our engine anticipates the market's systematic underpricing of correlated tail events. Additionally, the integration of cognitive signals (vision metrics, pocket depth) allows the agent to simulate the quarterback's real-time decision tree, effectively predicting how human perceptual limitations will manifest as exploitable statistical deviations from the market consensus.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: To prevent catastrophic leakage, a strict anti-collinearity veto is enforced between the prop projections and the DFS optimization layers. If a player's elevated prop conviction score is entirely driven by a systemic bias in the DK archive files rather than genuine FTN cognitive signals, the cross-layer validator triggers a rollback. Furthermore, the LiveRosterGate operates as a supreme veto authority; even if the DFS optimizer identifies a mathematically optimal lineup containing a high-value asset, a retroactive change in that player's status to 'Doubtful' instantly collapses their selection probability to zero, overriding all upstream economic valuations.
